examples.title: Complete field
examples.description: SelectField adds the label, options and supporting text. It now comes from the same Select module; the previous select-field import keeps working.

examples.title: Compose the primitives
examples.description: The original v1 composition stays available. Connect a visible label to the trigger, place options inside SelectContent, and choose your own layout.

examples.title: Controlled selection
examples.description: Own the value with value and onValueChange. External actions can update or clear it, while onSelect receives the full option object. Use defaultValue instead for uncontrolled selection.

examples.title: Search and keyboard
examples.description: Searchable fields filter labels locally. Keyboard opening focuses search. Type, then press ArrowDown or ArrowUp to enter the results; ArrowUp from the first result returns to search. Escape closes the list and returns to the field.

examples.title: Groups and dividers
examples.description: The group property creates labelled sections. separateGroups adds dividers and uppercase group labels. Disabled options remain visible and cannot be selected.

examples.title: Controlled search
examples.description: searchValue skips local filtering. Supply matching results yourself and reset the query when onSearchChange receives an empty string on close. This example filters a local array in the parent.

examples.title: Helper text and error
examples.description: error replaces helperText and links the problem through aria-describedby. SelectField keeps the v1 required marker; native constraint validation belongs on the Select root.

examples.title: Invalid primitive trigger
examples.description: aria-invalid="true" now applies the same error appearance as state="error". This works with validation libraries without an extra state prop.

examples.title: Disabled and loading
examples.description: Disabled and loading fields cannot open. Both use the same dimmed surface; loading also displays a spinner. All current v1 props retain their behavior.

examples.title: Long labels
examples.description: Options wrap by default so their full labels remain readable. truncateOptionText clips rows to one line; the selected value always truncates, and callbacks keep the full value.

examples.title: Empty and no results
examples.description: emptyMessage explains why there are no options. A search with no matching labels shows No results found. The popup still closes with Escape.

examples.title: Load more on scroll
examples.description: onScrollEnd fires when the viewport reaches the bottom. loadingMore shows progress; hasMore={false} stops callbacks and displays End of list. This uses a local delay to demonstrate paging.

examples.title: Intercept an action item
examples.description: interceptValue can prevent an option from becoming the value while onSelect still fires. Use controlled mode to keep the current selection visible.

examples.title: In a form
examples.description: name submits the selected value through Radix’s hidden native select. This example uses the primitive required prop for native browser validation. SelectField’s required prop preserves its v1 label-marker behavior.

examples.title: Inside a dialog
examples.description: The dropdown stays above the dialog and preserves the dialog’s scroll lock. Escape from the search closes the list first; a second Escape closes the dialog.
